scope: Offline moving-segment diagnosis only, frozen round72 model and existing tightened T1/newQ2. No fitting, new model branch, gain/guard edits, serial operations or physical capture.
tests: Reproduce full20s forced-input rollout with recorded moving commands/actual dt and40step hold means. No outcome-based run selection or physical force interpretation.

For each outward/return4s segment initialize position ONCE from its preceding recorded hold endpoint and velocity ONCE from the preceding80step encoder endpoint difference. Replay exact queued moving commands with no future measured-state injection. This is conditional moving prediction, not full-task or counterfactual closed-loop validation; replacing initial state can absorb other modeling errors and cannot uniquely blame holds.

Match native40ms motion feedback to preceding1ms queued interval by core-step index, verify encoder/RPM identities; compare ESC reported-current fields with raw queued commands at fixed lookbacks[-5,-2,-1,0,1,2,5,10] steps. Negative lookback uses future command as diagnostic control, not causal/predictive input. OLS associations are descriptive, not calibrated current-to-force gains or a chosen lag model.

Compare endpoint encoder displacement and integrated END-sampled RPM on fixed50/100step windows, actual elapsed time and physical right sign=-1. No fitted RPM offset, delay or quantizer and no claim that either noisy observation is exact velocity truth.

Analytic frozen mass/damping generalized eigenvalues and time constants, compared to1ms logged period. These characterize an estimated model, not measured hardware constants or proof of parameter unidentifiability.
evaluationPolicy: Use waveform errors, not just closeness of scalar taskRMS. No application tolerance invented, no newQ2 calibration, no model-admission claim. Preserve old loose Q2 results separately.
